title: Legacy of Yu
publicSourceReferences: Shem Phillips Solo Campaign Design Diary

milestones.title: The Rising Floodwaters
milestones.description: Digging the first drainage channels, harvesting timber, and repelling barbarian river raiders.

milestones.title: Villages of the Basin
milestones.description: Constructing granaries and outposts to house refugees while drafting artisans and monks into the labor force.

milestones.title: Cutting Through the Mountains
milestones.phase: Era III - The Great Gorge Engineering
milestones.description: Clearing boulder blockages and carving stone canals through Dragon Gate Mountain to divert surging waters.

milestones.title: The Barbarian Warlord's Siege
milestones.phase: Act IV - Defense of the Works
milestones.description: Bribing and battling invading barbarian warbands threatening to sabotage the canal lockworks.

milestones.title: The Waters Subdued
milestones.phase: Era V - Yu the Great Enthroned
milestones.description: Guiding the Yellow River safely to the Eastern Sea, winning seven imperial victories, and founding the Xia Dynasty.
